
---
title: "Patient profiles"
author: "`r params[['author']]`"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%B %d, %Y')`"
output:
  pdf_document:
    keep_tex: true
    fig_crop: false
    toc: true
    toc_depth: 3
    number_sections: false
    df_print: kable
    latex_engine: xelatex
    pandoc_args: ["-V", "monofont:DejaVu Sans Mono"]
    extra_dependencies: ["lscape", "fvextra"]
    includes:
      in_header: header.tex
geometry: margin=2cm
papersize: a4
params:  
  author: !r NULL
  include_provenance: !r NULL
  subjid_var: !r NULL
  subjid_vals: !r NULL
  subject_level_dataset_name: !r NULL
  summary: !r NULL
  listings: !r NULL
  plots: !r NULL
  dataset_list: !r NULL
  provenance: !r NULL
  # Document should be rendered via batch_patient_profiles, not by hand.
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  tidy = TRUE,
  fig.width = 10,
  fig.height = 6,
  out.width = "90%",
  dpi = 300,
  dev = "cairo_pdf"     # vector output, sharp text
)
    
```
  
```{r condition_catcher, include=FALSE}
# Warnings and messages are presented at the end
.condition_log <- data.frame(
  chunk = character(0),
  type = character(0),
  message = character(0),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

.log_condition <- function(type, x, options) {  
  lines <- strsplit(x, "\n", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  lines <- sub("^\\s*##\\s?", "", lines)
  keep <- which(nzchar(trimws(lines)))
  lines <- if (length(keep) == 0) character(0) else lines[min(keep):max(keep)]

  .condition_log[nrow(.condition_log) + 1L, ] <<- list(
    chunk = if (is.null(options$label)) "inline" else options$label,
    type = type,
    message = paste(lines, collapse = "\n")
  )
  "" # suppress default inline printing of the warning/message
}

knitr::knit_hooks$set(
  warning = function(x, options) .log_condition("warning", x, options),
  message = function(x, options) .log_condition("message", x, options)
)
```

```{r patient_chunks, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
# Use gsub instead of knitr::expand for simplicity
participant_chunk <- readLines("participant_chunk.Rmd")
for (idx in seq_along(params[["subjid_vals"]])) {
  current_subjid <- params[["subjid_vals"]][[idx]]
  res <- knitr::knit_child(
    text = gsub("{{IDX}}", idx, participant_chunk, fixed = TRUE),
    envir = list2env(list(
      current_subjid = current_subjid,
      idx = idx,
      params = params
    )),
    quiet = FALSE
  )
  cat(res, sep = '\n')
}
```

```{r data_provenance, echo = FALSE, results='asis', eval = params[["include_provenance"]]}
local({
  dataset_list <- params[["dataset_list"]]
  cat("\\section{Data source}\n\n\\subsection{Data Modification Dates:}\n\n")

  for (idx in seq_along(dataset_list)) {
    cat(sprintf(
      "\n\n **name**: `%s` **modification time**: %s",
      names(dataset_list)[[idx]],
      params[["provenance"]][["mtimes"]][[idx]]
    ))
  }

  cat(
    "\n\nThese dates are calculated while generating the output documentation.\n\n"
  )

  cat("\\subsection{Data hash:}\n\n")

  for (idx in seq_along(dataset_list)) {
    cat(sprintf(
      "\n\n **name**: `%s` **hash**: %s",
      names(dataset_list)[[idx]],
      params[["provenance"]][["hashes"]][[idx]]
    ))
  }

  cat("\n\nThese hashes are calculated while generating the documentation.\n\n")
})
```

```{r session_info, results = 'asis', eval = params[["include_provenance"]]}
local({
  # set width to 80 so it fits on an A4
  session_lines <- params[["provenance"]][["session_lines"]]
  max_char_width <- max(nchar(session_lines))

  session_lines <- paste0(session_lines, collapse = "\n")

  fmt <- "\n\n\\newpage\n\n\\beginwidepage{%d}\n\n\\begingroup\n\n\\wptabfont\n\n\\section{Session Info}\n\n\\begin{verbatim}\n\n%s\n\n\\end{verbatim}\n\n\\endgroup\n\n\\stopwidepage\n\n"
  cat(sprintf(fmt, max_char_width, session_lines))
})
```


```{r warnings-summary, echo=FALSE, results='asis', eval = params[["include_provenance"]]}
local({
  log <- .condition_log

  cat(sprintf(
    "\\section{Warnings \\& Messages \\texorpdfstring{\\textcolor{%s}{(%d)}}{(%d)}}\n\n",
    if (nrow(log) == 0) "black" else "red", nrow(log), nrow(log)
  ))

  # Use fvextra to allow breaking lines in verbatim sections.
  # Verbatim is required because special characters may appear.
  # It must be broken as message and errors can be pretty long.
  cat("\\begin{Verbatim}[breaklines, breakanywhere, breaksymbolleft={}, breakindentnchars=2]\n")

  if (nrow(log) == 0) {
    cat("No warnings or messages were produced during rendering.\n")
  }

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(log))) {
    row <- log[i, ]    
    body <- strsplit(row$message, "\n", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    if (i > 1) cat("\n") # Separate conditions, avoid trailing new line
    cat(
      sprintf("[%s] %s", toupper(row$type), row$chunk),
      paste0("  ", body),
      sep = "\n"
    )
  }

  cat("\\end{Verbatim}\n")
})
```
